_comment: Cron schedules for automation functions (UTC). Mirrors the Master Launch Guide Phase 7. Edit freely.

jobs.name: daily-catalog-seed
jobs._comment: Populates/tops-up the marketplace catalog for every country in CATALOG_COUNTRIES with original AI listings + images.

jobs.name: daily-category-images
jobs._comment: Spins up original category/subcategory tile images on the serverless GPU, once each (bounded per run).

jobs.name: daily-browse-node-expand
jobs._comment: AI-expands the taxonomy's 3rd level (browse nodes) a few subcategories per run, exceeding Amazon's node count over time.

jobs.name: daily-delivery-makegood-sweep
jobs._comment: All-tiers DELIVERY make-good true-up. For every active advertising seat past its guarantee term, compares delivered impressions to the guaranteed volume and, on a shortfall, grants a FREE make-good (extends delivery at no charge until the guaranteed volume is served — bounded, never more than what was sold), records an AdvertiserMakeGood, and emails the advertiser. Closes out make-goods once met/expired. Guarantees delivery we control, never revenue/ROI. Respects DELIVERY_GUARANTEE_ENABLED.

jobs.name: weekly-advertiser-ai-report
jobs._comment: Automatic weekly AI performance report for EVERY advertiser across ALL tiers/offers: measures the conventional PPC metric set (impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, conversions, CPA, revenue, ROAS/ROI) + social/engagement-driven traffic and revenue from REAL activity, benchmarks it against standard PPC norms, has the AI write recommendations, stores an AdvertiserReport, and emails the advertiser. Never guarantees an ROI; below the data threshold it reports 'still gathering data'. Respects AI_ADVERTISER_REPORTS_ENABLED.

jobs.name: daily-premium-ppc-autoadvertise
jobs._comment: AI writes+queues #ad-disclosed social posts for each paying PPC advertiser (until they've doubled their $ in orders) on consenting survey-members' connected accounts, plus a daily post for the platform's own business. Respects the social_posting kill switch; defaults posts to pending_approval.

jobs.name: daily-tier2-ai-ad-manager
jobs._comment: Self-learning Tier 2 ad manager: measures each advertiser's real attributed ROAS, records learning signals (OptimizationSignal + AgentLearningMemory under agent tier2_ad_manager), re-weights the A-D delivery mix toward what's working, and dispatches each deliverable to its AI engine. No per-advertiser human. Respects the ai_ad_manager flag.

jobs.name: telemetry-stats-6h
jobs._comment: Rolls interaction telemetry into funnel/scroll/drop-off statistics and publishes OptimizationSignals for the self-learning loop.

jobs.name: session-capture-analyze-6h
jobs._comment: Reviews a batch of SAMPLED session screenshots for UX issues, hard-capped by SESSION_CAPTURE_DAILY_BUDGET_USD / AI_DAILY_SPEND_CAP_USD. No-op unless the session_screenshots flag is on.

jobs.name: self-learning-cycle-daily
jobs._comment: Master self-improvement pass: collect+analyze telemetry/capture/KYC -> refresh site model -> propose small, statistically-backed changes -> A/B test with a customer survey -> deploy winners. Money/compliance stays human-gated.

jobs.name: live-experiment-tick-10m
jobs._comment: Real-time monitor for live A/B holdouts: measure -> circuit breaker -> bandit traffic-shift -> canary ramp -> promote-if-significant / expire-if-inconclusive. No-downtime config flips.

jobs.name: graduation-scan-2h
jobs._comment: Promotes strong segment winners to a site-wide 24h validation experiment; a pass flips globally (web/PWA/native) with no downtime. Money/compliance excluded.

jobs.name: learning-overhead-monitor-hourly
jobs._comment: Watches the self-learning system's own footprint (telemetry/metric/snapshot volume + AI spend) and auto-throttles within bounds so measurement never becomes the cost.

jobs.name: points-boost-daily-harvest
jobs._comment: Daily 'harvest': auto-credits each user's accrued Points Boost growth (non-cashable, capped per BOOST_DAILY/LIFETIME_CAP_USD, breakage-funded).

jobs.name: daily-growth-budget-plan
jobs._comment: Computes the growth-budget plan, stores a GrowthPlan snapshot, and alerts if the redemption reserve is underfunded.

jobs.name: survey-commitment-reminder
jobs._comment: Hourly: nudges users whose chosen survey time has come and who haven't hit the $8 goal; awards streak-milestone bonuses.

jobs.name: adgrid-slot-reallocation
jobs._comment: Daily (REALLOC_CUTOFF_HOUR_UTC): hands unused premium AdGrid slots to high-value non-premium earners as one-day passes.

jobs.name: funnel-benchmark-compile-daily
jobs._comment: Daily: aggregates real customer results per product and auto-publishes substantiated 'typical' benchmarks (median + basis) once each product's sample passes AI_FUNNEL_BENCHMARK_MIN_SAMPLE. Below threshold, the concierge keeps showing the hypothetical example. Set AI_FUNNEL_BENCHMARK_REQUIRE_APPROVAL to gate publishing behind admin sign-off.

jobs.name: funnel-reengage-sweep-daily
jobs._comment: Daily AI-concierge Gate-2 re-engagement. STARTS IN DRY-RUN (counts who WOULD be emailed, sends nothing) so you can check volumes first. To go live, set "body" to { "dry_run": false } (or remove it). Sends stay consent-gated (canEmailMarket), frequency-capped, and bounded by FUNNEL_SWEEP_MAX_PER_RUN.

jobs.name: product-stats-compile-daily
jobs._comment: Daily: aggregates real Orders per product into ProductStat (units, buyers, median/avg revenue). Publishes results once a product passes PRODUCT_STATS_MIN_SAMPLE; below that it stays 'gathering data' (show how it works). Run with {dry_run:true} to preview.

jobs.name: daily-video-trend-refresh
jobs._comment: Searches the internet each morning (live Google-Trends daily searches, AI-curated) and refreshes the AI Video Engine's trend pool so concepts ride current events. Provider follows VIDEO_ENGINE_TREND_PROVIDER (default 'auto').

jobs.name: daily-video-autopilot-start
jobs._comment: Starts one end-to-end AI video run each morning (after the trend refresh): generate concepts -> build a user poll -> collect votes. It then waits for the human approval gate (or auto-approves once autonomy is earned).

jobs.name: video-autopilot-tick
jobs._comment: Every 4 hours: advance any run whose poll is ready — learn from votes, select render winners, then auto-approve (if trust earned) or park at the human gate.

jobs.name: feedback-auto-collect
jobs._comment: Hourly: mine the site's page telemetry (dwell/scroll/friction/purchases) into implicit feedback signals per domain — automatic, no user prompts.
